    description: E2E (Playwright) tests must never interfere with user-invoked or other daemons. Tests
      must use ephemeral ports, isolated HOME/config, and deterministic cleanup — never killing
      processes by port number. This extends the vitest isolation patterns from
      @daemon-sensitive-cli-test-determinism to the Playwright E2E test infrastructure.
    depends_on: []
    implements: []
    relates_to: []
    tests: []
    traits: []
    notes: []
    created: 2026-03-05T17:35:25.175Z
    acceptance_criteria:
      - id: ac-1
        given: E2E tests need a daemon for API/browser testing
        when: the Playwright test fixture starts a daemon
        then: the daemon binds to an ephemeral port (OS-assigned, port 0) so it never conflicts with user
          daemons or parallel test runs
      - id: ac-2
        given: a daemon is running on the default port (3456) before tests start
        when: E2E tests execute
        then: the user's daemon is never killed, stopped, or interfered with — tests use their own isolated
          port
      - id: ac-3
        given: E2E tests start a daemon in a temp directory
        when: the test fixture sets up the daemon environment
        then: HOME and config paths are isolated so daemon PID/port state does not leak to or from the
          ambient system
      - id: ac-4
        given: E2E tests complete (pass or fail)
        when: the Playwright test fixture tears down
        then: the test daemon is stopped via scoped kspec serve stop (not process killing) and temp
          directories are cleaned up
      - id: ac-5
        given: the test daemon port is dynamically assigned
        when: Playwright tests make API calls or navigate browser pages
        then: the port is propagated to all test fixtures and page URLs via the daemon fixture context
    status:
      maturity: draft
      implementation: implemented
